note: FNS 1157.3 lists QC variance examples for the homeless shelter deduction — these are audit scenarios for QC reviewers to look for during case reviews, not caseworker policy requirements. The underlying policy rules referenced by these variances (who qualifies as homeless, when to allow the deduction, actual vs standard deduction choice) ARE covered in the OLG. The 'Shelter Deduction for Homeless Households' page covers eligibility criteria (all members must be homeless, must incur or expect to incur shelter/utility expenses), the choice between standard homeless deduction and actual shelter expenses with verification, and the BEACON Homeless Indicator that automates the higher-of calculation. The 'Shelter Expenses Deduction' page addresses homeless households in its own section. The documentation and reviewer reasoning requirements in 1157.3 are QC review standards, not caseworker procedures — the OLG appropriately does not replicate QC audit methodology.
